name: ExtrudedSprite3D
shortDescription: Turns 2D sprite animations into extruded 3D meshes that receive light and cast shadows.
description: An animated sprite extruded into a real 3D mesh. Edit animations like a regular Sprite, then use the normal 3D object width, height, and depth controls to size it. Front and back faces are textured with the sprite image, side walls are generated where solid pixels touch transparent pixels, so the object can receive 3D lights and cast silhouette-accurate shadows.
